content.title: ABB 391-1931 Variable Frequency Drive, Three Phase Input, 45 A Rated Output Current
content.short_description: ABB 391-1931 variable frequency drive with three phase input and 45 A rated output current for industrial motor control applications.
content.long_description:
The ABB 391-1931 is a variable frequency drive (VFD) designed for three phase input power systems. It delivers a rated output current of 45 A, suitable for controlling three phase motor loads in industrial settings.

This drive falls under ABB's Drives & Controls product line and is used to regulate motor speed and torque by varying output frequency and voltage. Confirm input voltage, enclosure rating, and motor horsepower compatibility against your application requirements before specifying, as these details are not listed in the available specifications.

Use MPN 391-1931 when cross-referencing or ordering replacement units to ensure correct fit within existing ABB drive systems.
